_why_every_source_is_a_literal_path: Two of these rules used unnamed capture groups — /(index|rise-sports).html
and /icons/(.*) — which newer path-to-regexp rejects outright with
'Unexpected (' rather than ignoring. This file is only read when the build
root is the repository root, which is why it never mattered while Vercel was
building web/, and why every deploy has failed since the root directory was
changed on 2026-09-01: the last good build was 2026-08-31 and the first
failure was an EMPTY commit, so no code was involved.
There are four icons and two HTML entry points, all known by name, so the
patterns bought nothing. Literal paths are valid under every version.
